props.name: debounce
props.comment: Debounce delay in ms for debounced `setFilters` calls. Default 500.

props.name: filter
props.comment: Permanent filter merged into the reference lookup.

props.name: perPage
props.comment: Page size for the related list. Default 25.

props.name: record
props.comment: The record whose id is matched. Defaults to the ambient record.

props.name: reference
props.comment: The referenced resource holding the reverse FK (e.g. `"books"`).

props.name: sort
props.comment: Initial sort of the related list. Default id ascending.

props.name: source
props.comment: The field on the current record the `target` matches. Default `"id"`.

props.name: storeKey
props.comment: KV namespace for the list params and selection. Default `${reference}.${target}.${id}`; `false` keeps them in memory.

props.name: target
props.comment: The FK field on the reference pointing back at this record (e.g. `"author_id"`).
